title: Point probabilities of an independent product
statement: Let $I$ be a finite index set, let $A_i$ be a finite set for each $i\in I$, and choose a probability mass function $p_i$ on each $A_i$. The independent product distribution on tuples $x=(x_i)_{i\in I}$ assigns probability $\prod_{i\in I}p_i(x_i)$ to $x$.
hypotheses_covered: a probability mass function on each coordinate
a tuple with one value in each coordinate set
